items.summary: The National Land Monetization Corporation (NLMC), under the administrative control of the Department of Public Enterprises (DPE), Ministry of Finance, Government of India, organised a Pre-Bid Meeting in New Delhi today, in connection with the proposed e-auction of a strategically located land parcel owned by HIL (India) Limited.
items.title: NLMC Organises Pre-Bid Meeting for E-Auction of 5.119-Acre HIL (India) Limited Land Parcel in New Delhi

items.summary: Union Minister of Commerce and Industry Shri Piyush Goyal called upon young people to be ambitious, embrace transformation and contribute to nation-building while delivering the keynote address at the Young Leaders Discourse Forum at Kirori Mal College, New Delhi, today.
items.title: Commerce and Industry Minister Shri Piyush Goyal Calls Upon Youth to Lead India’s Journey Towards Becoming a Developed Nation by 2047

items.summary: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah today addressed the concluding ceremony of the Chhattisgarh Rajyotsav in Raipur. On this occasion, Chhattisgarh Chief Minister Shri Vishnu Deo Sai and Deputy Chief Minister Shri Vijay Sharma, along with several other dignitaries, were present.
items.title: Union Home and Cooperation Minister Shri Amit Shah addresses the closing ceremony of the Chhattisgarh Rajyotsav in Raipur today
